findings: AnalyticsSnapshot frontend type declares `recorded_at`, `num_alerts`, and `period_hours` fields that do not exist on the backend AnalyticsSnapshotOut schema (backend uses `captured_at`; `num_alerts` and `period_hours` have no model column). ComparisonChart.tsx accesses `num_alerts` at runtime and will render `undefined` for both rows.
avg_response_time_seconds is `float | None` in AnalyticsSnapshotOut but ComparisonChart.tsx calls `.toFixed(1)` on it without a null guard — will throw TypeError when the backend returns null.

No code writes AnalyticsSnapshot rows. The scheduler tick in main.py never creates an AnalyticsSnapshot, so GET /api/analytics/comparison always returns an empty list and the comparison page is permanently empty.
